1.consolidated_definition: En sentido metafórico, lanzar peticiones para obtener beneficios. Neologismo anglicado, poco frecuente. “Éste es el país de la pichaera. Si el Gobierno pichea para recibir ayudas, para que te arregle la luz, pa’ to’ te pichean y que en el género picheen, no es na’ “, asegura (Primera Hora, 30-01-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition: In a metaphorical sense, to launch petitions in order to obtain benefits. Anglicized neologism, relatively infrequent. "This is the country of those who beg for favors. If the government begs for aid, to have the light fixed, for everyone to beg and that in the matter of begging, there's nothing," it asserts (First Hour, 30-01-07)
